capabilities: Set, unset, and toggle the publish property from the command palette
Copy the published page URL using a configurable URL template
Configure property keys, slug style, and URL template
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool itself; it only edits frontmatter properties for an external publishing system you already have.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Custom publishing setups that rely on frontmatter properties have no built-in commands to quickly mark pages published, toggle visibility, or copy the published URL.
summary: Command palette plugin that sets publish and visibility frontmatter properties and copies URLs for pages in custom publishing workflows.
